raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 7, Reason for Mistake: Despite correctly identifying the directors and their birth dates (Peter Del Monte: 1943; Shane Black: 1961), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Shane Black was born earlier, reversing the chronological comparison and thus choosing the wrong film.
